seo.metaTitle: Signature cleaner — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Lift a signature off paper onto a clear background. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/photo/signature-clean-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Signature cleaner processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/photo/signature-clean-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does Signature cleaner upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Signature cleaner executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/photo/signature-clean-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.
